notes: Source on file is the Introduced-in-House (IH) version (1767 chars); cache shows the bill has since passed the House and been placed on the Senate calendar, but all four operative changes described match the IH text, so no version-drift error was found in the analysis content. referencedSources is empty, so descriptions of the underlying §317U/§2822 program substance (agency = CDC, 'state and local' scope, 'activities of the Centers' structure) are UNSUPPORTED-by-source (unfetched prior statute) and recorded minor. Coverage/omission pass: all four operative provisions (317U(f) window, 2822(c) window, 317U(b) consultee strike, 317U(c)(4) capacity insertion) are covered — no material omission. featured_quotes is a Congressional-Record floor statement not present in the bill-text source and with no registered referencedSource, so it is out of scope for this source-only audit and carries no claim row. One MATERIAL flag: top_lines[1].subs[2] asserts the change 'broadens the pool CDC must consult', a direction inversion — the amendment removes a mandatory named consultee and keeps only a general catch-all, contradicting the analysis's own correct framing elsewhere.
